title: AVX512/VBMI2: A Programmer's Perspective
relevance: Practical guide to VBMI2 instructions from a database engineer. Demonstrates compress/expand for byte-level data manipulation in production database workloads.

title: AVX512VBMI2 and packed varuint format
relevance: Demonstrates VBMI2 compress/expand for decoding packed variable-length integers. Directly applicable to JSON number token extraction.

title: Parsing JSON faster with Intel AVX-512
relevance: Analysis of AVX-512 benefits for JSON parsing, including discussion of wider registers and new instruction capabilities.

title: VPCOMPRESSB/VPCOMPRESSW — Store Sparse Packed Byte/Word Integer Values Into Dense Memory/Register
relevance: Official instruction specification for VPCOMPRESSB. Defines the compress semantics used in this concept.
